title: Laredo College Instructor Micheal Longhofer Opens ‘Subject Matters’ Exhibit Nov. 5
excerpt: Laredo College Fine Arts instructor Micheal Longhofer opens his ‘Subject Matters’ exhibit Nov. 5 at the Martha Fenstermaker Memorial Visual Arts Gallery, marking his new role as the college’s painting and drawing instructor.
content:
Laredo College Fine Arts instructor Micheal Longhofer will open his exhibit “Subject Matters” with a reception Thursday, November 5, from 5 to 8 p.m. at the Martha Fenstermaker Memorial Visual Arts Gallery, according to Laredo College.

The exhibit showcases Longhofer’s artistic journey and marks the beginning of his new role as Laredo College’s painting and drawing instructor, the college reported.

Longhofer draws inspiration from the human figure and figurative elements in rural and urban landscapes, merging the contours of the human figure with the forms of the urban landscape to explore the balance between humanity and architecture, according to Laredo College.

“I find inspiration from the people around me, nature and the world at large,” Longhofer said, according to the college.

With more than 30 years of experience as a realist painter and visual artist, Longhofer works in oil and acrylic painting, the college reported. The exhibit remains on display through January 19. Gallery hours are Monday through Thursday from 9 a.m. to 5:30 p.m. and Friday from 9 a.m. to noon.
